name: Commercial Mandarin Orange Cultivation (1-Acre High-Density Model)
description: High-quality commercial cultivation of Nagpur Mandarin (120 trees/acre at 6mx6m spacing) with drip fertigation and Mrig Bahar crop regulation. Total project cost: Rs 1.75L/acre. Financially viable with 18.1% IRR, 2.35 DSCR, 35% capital subsidy, and Rs 30k/yr intercropping income during gestation.
source: National Horticulture Board (NHB) - 1 Acre Bankable Model

name: Disease-Free Certified Citrus Nursery
description: Production of certified disease-free planting material using ICAR-CCRI Shoot Tip Grafting (STG) and containerized nursery protocol in shade-net houses. Highly profitable due to massive replanting demand across Vidarbha.

name: Micro-Budding Commercial Citrus Propagation Unit
description: Fast-track multiplication of commercial citrus cultivars using CCRI micro-budding protocol. Reduces nursery gestation from 18 to 12 months and cuts sapling production cost by 30%.

name: Certified Citrus Rootstock Seed Supply
description: Harvesting, extraction, testing and sale of certified Phytophthora-tolerant rootstock seeds (Rangpur Lime, Rough Lemon, Carrizo) for commercial citrus nurseries.

name: Mechanized Custom Hiring Center: Orchard Pruning & Canopy Training
description: Provision of tractor-mounted hydraulic pruning, hedging and topping equipment to maintain tree framework, prevent canopy shading, and enhance fruit size uniformity.

name: Electrostatic Orchard Spraying & Drone Pest Management
description: Precision application of micro-nutrients and bio-pesticides using electrostatic sprayers and agricultural drones, achieving 40% reduction in chemical wastage.

name: Trichoderma & Bio-Formulations Manufacturing Unit
description: Commercial production of Trichoderma harzianum and microbial antagonists developed by CCRI for biological control of root rot and Phytophthora gummosis.

name: Mechanized Optical Sorting, Grading & 3-Tier Packing Line
description: High-throughput optical grading line (5 MT/hour) that washes, cleans, fungicides, sorts by color/size/blemish, waxes, and packs fruit in corrugated CFB boxes.
source: APMC Warud Model Packhouse / NHB Norms

name: Organic Fruit Surface Waxing & Antifungal Coating Line
description: Application of post-harvest stayfresh high-shine wax (2.5%) and lac-based fruit coatings with Bavistin to extend fruit shelf life to 3-4 weeks for domestic long-distance transport.

name: Farm-Gate Solar Cold Rooms (10 MT Micro-Cold Storage)
description: Decentralized solar-powered cold rooms located near orchard clusters maintaining 8-10°C and 90-95% RH to eliminate post-harvest distress sales during peak harvest.

name: Ready-to-Serve (RTS) & Carbonated Citrus Bottling Plant
description: Commercial bottling of RTS beverages (5-6% real juice) and carbonated citrus soft drinks (15% juice) using Nagpur mandarin and acid lime with FSSAI compliance.

name: Not-From-Concentrate (NFC) Cold-Pressed Fresh Orange Juice
description: Production of 100% pure, natural, cold-pressed fresh orange juice with no added sugar or water, packaged in premium recyclable bottles for urban metro distribution.

name: Spray-Dried Mandarin Juice Powder & Instant Premixes
description: High-tech spray drying of clarified Nagpur mandarin juice into free-flowing instant reconstituted powder, retaining over 75% natural Vitamin C and aroma volatiles.

name: Acid Lime Nutri-Jelly & Vitamin-C Fruit Spreads
description: Value-added pectin-gelled fruit confectionery enriched with natural citrus Vitamin C, targeting healthy school-snack and functional confectionery segments.

name: Gourmet Nagpur Orange Marmalade & Artisanal Jams
description: Small-batch production of premium bittersweet orange marmalade utilizing natural shredded peel, targeting gourmet breakfast tables and bakery ingredient supply.

name: Frozen Citrus Pulp & Bulk Aseptic Puree Processing
description: Aseptic extraction, deaeration, and flash pasteurization of citrus pulp packed in 200L aseptic drums for year-round supply to ice cream, bakery, and dairy manufacturers.

name: Cold-Pressed Orange Peel Essential Oil (D-Limonene) Extraction
description: High-value extraction of essential oil from waste citrus peels via mechanical rasping and cold pressing. D-Limonene is widely used in perfumery, cosmetics, and organic solvents.

name: Citrus Pectin Extraction from Processing Waste (Albedo)
description: Industrial extraction and drying of high-methoxyl pectin from citrus peel pomace. Serves as an import-substitute gelling agent for domestic jam, jelly, and pharma manufacturing.

name: Pelletized Cattle Feed from Dehydrated Citrus Pomace
description: Zero-waste valorization converting wet juice-processing peel waste into nutritious, high-energy digestible fiber feed pellets for dairy cattle.
target_market: Dairy Farmers & Feed Mills in Vidarbha

name: Citrus Bio-Enzyme Multi-Purpose Cleaning Solutions
description: Eco-friendly fermentation of fresh orange peels with jaggery and water to produce all-natural, chemical-free enzymes for home cleaning, floor washes, and grease removal.

name: Ventilated Corrugated Fibreboard (CFB) Box Manufacturing
description: Manufacturing of 5-ply export-grade ventilated corrugated boxes with high burst strength to replace traditional bruising-prone wooden crates for citrus transport.

name: GI-Tagged Nagpur Mandarin Export Aggregation Hub
description: Aggregation, pre-cooling, barcode tracing, and phytosanitary certification of Grade-A Mrig Bahar crop for export to Gulf and European markets under the GI tag.
target_market: Middle East, UK, and European Importers

name: Citrus Orchard Agri-Tourism & Experiential Farm Stays
description: Developing orchard tourism infrastructure offering fruit-picking trails, blossom blossom tours, farm dinners, and rustic cottages during the winter Ambia harvest.
target_market: Urban Tourists, Weekend Travelers & School Groups

name: Reefer Container Transportation Fleet for Citrus
description: Dedicated fleet of refrigerated trucks (4-8 MT) equipped with data loggers to transport pre-cooled citrus from Nagpur packhouses to Mumbai/JNPT port and northern metros.

name: Citrus Disease Diagnostic & Leaf Analysis Mobile Clinic
description: Mobile testing van equipped with LAMP/PCR diagnostic kits and soil sensors to provide rapid on-farm diagnostics for Phytophthora, greening (HLB), and micro-nutrient deficiencies.
